questions.q: Radu ___ answer my email yesterday. Maybe he was busy.
questions.explainRo: Negația la trecut este didn't + verbul la forma de bază (answer).

questions.q: My parents bought their first car thirty years ___.
questions.explainRo: „Acum treizeci de ani” = thirty years ago; ago stă după perioada de timp.

questions.q: ___ you at the office on Monday? – No, I was at home.
questions.explainRo: Cu verbul to be la trecut nu folosim did: Were you...?

questions.q: Victor worked very hard at the company, and last month he got a ___. Now he is a team leader.
questions.explainRo: Promotion = promovare: acum Victor conduce o echipă.
După did verbul stă la forma de bază: leave, nu left.

questions.q: We ___ (not / see) the sea on our holiday. It rained every day!
questions.explainRo: După didn't verbul rămâne la forma de bază: didn't see, nu „didn't saw”.

questions.q: When ___ your brother graduate from university?
questions.explainRo: Întrebare la trecut: When + did + subiect + verbul la forma de bază.

questions.q: My grandfather ___ (grow up) on a farm near Sibiu.
questions.explainRo: Grow up este neregulat: grow up → grew up (a crește, a copilări).
Did + subiect + verbul la forma de bază (hire).

questions.ro: Ne-am cunoscut la un concert acum zece ani.
questions.explainRo: Ago stă după perioada de timp: ten years ago.

questions.audio: My colleagues didn't come to the party.
answers: My colleagues didn't come to the party.
My colleagues did not come to the party.
questions.ro: Colegii mei nu au venit la petrecere.
questions.explainRo: Didn't come: după didn't verbul rămâne la forma de bază (come, nu came).

answers: When did you graduate from high school?
When did you finish high school?
questions.explainRo: Întrebare la trecut: When did you + graduate from (nu uita de from).
